zh: 岛主，这回想选哪一个？
有几样都能做，想听听你的意思。
我想好了两种办法，你挑一个好吗？
要不要按你喜欢的来？
路过来问问，这次你想怎样？
大家让我来问问你，我们选哪个？
en: Which one would you like?
We have a few real choices. What do you fancy?
I have two ideas. Will you pick one?
Shall we do it your way this time?
I came to ask what you would enjoy next.
Everyone sent me to ask: which shall we choose?

zh: 那我就选{choice}啦～
先试试{choice}，等你有主意再告诉我。
这次我来拿主意：{choice}。
你先歇着，我们就做{choice}吧。
我觉得{choice}不错，那就这么定啦。
大家先按{choice}来，我会照看好的。
en: I'll pick {choice}, then.
Let us try {choice}. You can tell me your idea later.
My vote this time goes to {choice}.
You can rest. We will start with {choice}.
{choice} sounds lovely to me. Settled!
We will go with {choice}. I will keep an eye on things.

zh: 我们要一起玩一会儿，你也来吗？
给你留个位置，好不好？
岛主，要不要和我们待一会儿？
我来请你啦，愿意一起吗？
大家都在等开场，你有空吗？
这回也想叫上你，来吗？
en: We are getting together. Would you like to come?
May I save you a place?
Would you like a little time with us?
Here is your invitation. Coming along?
Everyone is nearly ready. Are you free?
We would love your company. Will you join us?

zh: {choice}做完啦，来跟你说一声。
刚刚把{choice}办好了，大家都回来了。
岛主，{choice}已经妥当啦。
我们把{choice}做好了，歇一会儿再出发。
回来报个好消息：{choice}完成啦。
{choice}有了真实成果，你放心吧。
en: {choice} is finished. I wanted to tell you myself.
We have finished {choice}, and everyone is back.
{choice} is all taken care of.
{choice} is done. We will rest before moving on.
Good news: we have completed {choice}.
We have real results from {choice} now.

zh: 大家歇一会儿，等我看看下一件事。
先在这儿待一小会儿吧。
不急着走，聚在一起喘口气。
这一件忙完了，大家靠近些。
下一件等会儿，我们先歇歇。
坐一小会儿，再慢慢往前走。
en: Let us rest while I check what comes next.
We can stay here for a little while.
No rush. Let us catch our breath together.
That is one thing finished. Gather round.
The next job can wait a moment.
A little rest, then we will carry on.

zh: 我想先把{choice}办好，大家跟我来。
接下来做{choice}吧，路上一起走。
{choice}还等着我们呢，我来带路。
我看过了，现在可以做{choice}。
先做{choice}，做完大家歇一会儿。
我们一起去办{choice}，不用着急。
en: Let us take care of {choice} first. Follow me.
Next is {choice}. We will walk together.
{choice} is waiting for us. I will lead the way.
I checked: we can do {choice} now.
First {choice}, then a little rest.
Let us go and do {choice}. There is no hurry.
